title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (NYSE:HPE)’s DaaS would include Apple products
text:
February 20, 2018 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (NYSE:HPE)’s DaaS would include Apple products 
The was a biggest news of last week, that Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (NYSE:HPE)’s DaaS would now include Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) products, pairing the iPhones, iPads, Macs, and more with HP’s support, services, and analytics capabilities. 
It was said the company that adding Apple Inc, to its support portfolio will further solidify its’s position as the leading multi-OS device management solution on the market. Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (NYSE:HPE) already knows that people love their Apple products, and with this move, allows HP to get a cut of the action and appeal to the many enterprises that have already settled on iOS as their preferred platform.
